about: Known answers for the light node contracts: identity, the wallet-key and ping-key messages, the device layer and QNet Link revision 2. Checked by the app (__tests__/LightNodeVectors.test.js), the extension (test/light-node-vectors.test.mjs), the site (src/lib/__tests__/light-node-vectors.test.mjs) and, later, the node.
encodings: Preimages are UTF-8 text. Keys, hashes and ML-DSA-65 signatures are lowercase hex; ML-DSA-65 signatures are raw 3309-byte FIPS 204 signatures, deterministic (rnd = 32 zero bytes) with an empty context, except a `reserve` answer's, which signs the site-record envelope of its reservation message with the context QNET_OFFCHAIN_MSG_v1 (constants.siteRecord). P-256 public keys are 65-byte uncompressed SEC1 points; device signatures are DER (b64url) and, for Android, also raw r||s (hex); nonces, key ids and QNet Link wire values are unpadded base64url; every u64 in a JSON body is a decimal string. Device keys, the ping key, the oracle key and the burner key are test keys from labels.
